listing.name: Ridiculous Weapon Pack
listing.summary: Do you think large missiles are too weak? This is for you. Adds incredibly broken versions of both the Hurricane MIRV and Hydra MDEM. Also paints the Reaper blue. If you want it red, follow the included instructions in the "Red" folder.

description:
Ridiculous Weapon Pack

Did you think large missiles weren't strong enough?  This is for you.

Adds a variant of the Hurricane MIRV that splits into Reapers, and a variant of the Hydra MDEM that splits into Dragonfires.

Also makes the Reaper blue.

If you want the Reaper to be red again, follow the instructions in the "Red" folder included.

Not balanced, and not intended to be.

Download Here.
